scientific_integrity: Universal claims are established by a written analytic proof. Finite enumeration and recurrence checks serve as independent consistency checks, not exhaustive infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Only a binary pure-strategy best-shot public-goods game on an undirected ring with exactly one added tie is proved; equilibrium count is not welfare, dynamics or equilibrium selection. Historical priority is provisional in view of possible unindexed chorded-cycle enumeration.
title: A single social tie can raise best-shot equilibrium multiplicity: exact chord placement on rings
